messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor here, can you provide the full chain-of-custody and log snapshots for the RBAC change tied to PR #4821? Need: who requested, who approved, KMS key alias used for any exported artifacts, and the Splunk/ELK query you used to pull the change events. SOC2 timeline is by EOD PDT.

emily: Hey @auditor_jane — noted. We'll assemble k8s audit logs + GitHub PR history + GCS/S3 export meta. Quick Q: do you need raw logline exports or a signed artifact bundle? :thinking: 

auditor_jane: Signed artifact bundle preferred (hash + timestamp). Also need retention policy proof and proof of approval (approver's id + timestamp).

alex: assigning: i'll pull the RBAC rolebinding events and generate a tarball with checksums. using this kubectl audit query to get events:

```
kubectl get events --field-selector reason=RoleBindingChange -A --since=48h -o json
```

will store export at s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-21/rbac-4821.tar.gz and encrypt with alias/ci/compliance-key

priya: FYI the KMS alias is aws:kms:alias/redwood/compliance/ci-key (customer-managed). We rotated that key 2026-01-10 — will include key rotation logs and policy binding.

sec-bot: Export job submitted by alex at 2026-03-21T15:12:03Z — artifact_id: art-20260321-4821 — status: in_progress

emily: For approval proof: PR 4821 shows approvals from @jason (team-lead) and @maria (security). GitHub audit log snippet:

```
gh api repos/redwood/infra/pulls/4821/reviews --jq '.[] | {user: .user.login, state: .state, submitted_at: .submitted_at}'
```

alex: vuln triage note — PR included a fix for CVE-2026-0452 (low severity) in the RBAC reconciliation code. Ticket RW-1129 links to the patch. We'll include the triage notes and timeline.

priya: For chain-of-custody, I'll attach the KMS GenerateDataKey logs and the IAM assume-role entries showing who ran the export role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/compliance-exporter). Also include CloudTrail event IDs.

auditor_jane: Good. Can you confirm retention windows? The control requires 1 year for audit logs and 3 years for signed artifacts.

emily: Audit logs are retained 18 months in Splunk by default; compliance exports are stored in the S3 bucket with a 3-year lifecycle + Object Lock enabled. We'll include the lifecycle policy JSON and S3 object metadata.

alex: attaching a sample splunk search I'm running for the exact timeline (will paste results into the bundle):

```
index=k8s_audit "RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding" | where change.user="alex" OR change.pr_number=4821 | table _time, user, verb, objectRef, responseStatus
```

sec-bot: Artifact art-20260321-4821 completed and uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-21/rbac-4821.tar.gz; sha256: 3b2f...a9c

priya: Added KMS logs: CloudTrail event 0b8f1e7c, key_alias: alias/redwood/compliance/ci-key, key_id: 8a1f-xxxx. Will include rotation history and policy document.

emily: Also adding runbook link for incident/triage and evidence packaging: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/compliance/evidence-packaging

auditor_jane: Thanks — can you also enumerate the fallback access path used during the incident (emergency admin) and who executed it? We need the emergency_access runbook reference.

alex: Emergency admin escalation recorded under Incident#INC-2026-0319. Escalation executed by @maria at 2026-03-19T03:06:41Z using bastion-bastion1 -> assume-role: emergency-admin. I'll include session recordings and the IAM session name.

priya: note: HSM-backed keys used for signing are managed via AWS CloudHSM in the compliance account. We'll include KMS to HSM mapping and certificate chain.

emily: plan: we'll produce the signed bundle (tar.gz + .sha256 + .sig) and post to the auditor SFTP by 2026-03-21T22:00Z. Any objections?

auditor_jane: Sounds good. One last ask — please include a short narrative timeline (1-2 paragraphs) summarizing what changed, why, who approved, and mitigation steps. That helps the SOC2 mapping.

alex: will draft timeline and attach. tagging @priya @emily for final sign-off :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Reminder: retention scan scheduled for this bucket in 7 days. :bell:

emily: ack, will confirm artifact lifecycle after upload.

auditor_jane: Great — thanks everyone, will follow up if anything else shows up during review. :pray:
